findings.current:
That was why Sama Pyo couldn’t look away now.

He could have dodged, but he couldn’t.
findings.defect: “Couldn’t look away” changes his inability to see an acceptable escape into an inability to avert his gaze.
findings.rationale: He can physically evade the Sword Energy, but doing so would leave an ally to die.
findings.replacement:
That was why, at this moment, Sama Pyo could see no way out.

He could have dodged, but he couldn’t.
findings.source:
그렇기에, 지금 이 순간 사마표의 눈에는 보이지 않았다.

분명 피할 수 있었으나, 피할 수 없었다.

findings.current: Why hadn’t they targeted this place, when Sima Gong commanded an army of thirty thousand and they were the key force on this battlefield?
findings.defect: “They” makes the Black Ghosts the key force; the source identifies Sima Gong’s thirty-thousand-strong army as that force.
findings.rationale: Sama Pyo is questioning why the Black Ghosts left his father’s strategically important army alone.
findings.replacement: Why hadn’t they targeted this place, when Sima Gong’s thirty-thousand-strong army was the key force on this battlefield?
findings.source: 흑야왕 사마공이 이끄는 삼만의 대병력이 있음에도, 이 전장의 핵심이라 할 수 있는 전력임에도 어찌 이곳만큼은 노리지 않았는가.

findings.current: His father had already made up his mind to go another way.
findings.defect: The draft turns Sima Gong’s concealed ulterior intentions into a definite decision to take another path.
findings.rationale: 다른 마음을 품다 indicates a hidden change of intention; the source does not specify a chosen course of action here.
findings.replacement: His father was already harboring other intentions.
findings.source: 자신의 아버지가 이미 다른 마음을 품었음을.

findings.current:
The treasured blade he’d given his son as his first and last gift now reflected the face of an old man with a troubled look in his eyes.

At that very moment, a distant flash of light erupted far away.
findings.defect: The draft omits that the distant flash is also reflected in the saber.
findings.rationale: 도신에 비친 빛 links the flash to what Sima Gong sees in the blade, not merely to a separate event.
findings.replacement:
The treasured blade he’d given his son as his first and last gift now reflected an old man with a troubled look in his eyes.

At that very moment, it also reflected a flash of light erupting far in the distance.
findings.source:
처음이자 마지막 선물로 아들에게 주었던 그 보도(寶刀)는, 어느덧 복잡한 눈빛을 한 늙은 사내를 비추고 있었다.

바로 그 순간. 저 멀리 터져 나온 아득한 섬광도 함께.

findings.current: Along with it came the sharp whistle of two unexpected projectiles.
findings.defect: The source specifies two sounds cutting through the air, not two projectiles.
findings.rationale: 파공성 describes the sounds; assigning them to projectiles adds an unsupported physical detail.
findings.replacement: He also heard two unexpected, sharp whistles cutting through the air.
findings.source: 생각지도 못했던 두 줄기의 날카로운 파공성도 함께.

findings.defect: The spaces prevent the marker from functioning as a Markdown footnote reference.
findings.rationale: The existing definition is otherwise left unreferenced.

summary: The draft changes Sama Pyo’s reason for not dodging, misidentifies the battlefield’s key force, and omits what Sima Gong sees reflected in the saber.
